name: Default
shortDescription: MediaWiki, the wiki engine behind Wikipedia, installed automatically on first start with a MariaDB database and persistent uploads.

alerts.message: The first start installs the wiki and creates the Admin account with the generated MW_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. MW_SITE_NAME, MW_LANG and MW_ADMIN_USER only apply to that first install; later changes go in LocalSettings.php on the data volume.
